tracerMethodology.finding: Of CTX-LEAVES2's three fixes, only the acreage earned-absence fix reaches this image through this pin. The other two are real fixes but reach production (if at all) through LDT's own separate deploys, not through hauska-factory's publish image. This qualifies the dispatch's four-counties framing: bumping this pin alone does not make Williamson's unmeasured-class failure pass -- that depends on LDT's live serve deployment separately reaching #649, which is outside this lane's write authority and unverified here.

checkDesign.rejectedDesign: pin !== LDT main -> fail (explicitly named as worse than nothing by the dispatch; fires on nearly every run since most LDT commits never touch the bake)
checkDesign.adoptedDesign: fail only if any file that differs between the pin and target (net tree diff, not per-commit union -- a change reverted within the range has zero net effect on what the bake would bundle) is a member of the module graph computed at the target commit
files: scripts/bake-module-graph.mjs -- the tracer, now a committed, reusable, exported function (previously ad hoc per CTX-PIN's own account)
scripts/ldt-sha-shape-guard.mjs -- 40-hex-lowercase shape guard, absent until now per CTX-PIN's report
scripts/check-ldt-pin-staleness.mjs -- composes both; reads the pin from cloudbuild.publish.yaml by default, accepts --pin/--main overrides for testing

ciVsScript.decision: both: a script (usable standalone/by a human/by the integration seat before a publish build) that ALSO runs automatically in CI, but in a dedicated workflow, not as a blocking job in ci.yml
ciVsScript.whyNotCiYml: ci.yml triggers on every branch push and PR fleet-wide. This check's subject (LDT's own history) is independent of what any given hauska-factory PR changes -- wiring it into the everything-gate would let LDT drifting on its own silently block unrelated lane merges, the same over-broad-control failure the dispatch names for the check's logic, just moved to blast radius. DEV_PROCESS 2.0/5.4 caution against a planner unilaterally creating a fleet-wide blocking policy; flagged here for the operator/integration seat to override if they want it stricter.
ciVsScript.chosenTrigger: new .github/workflows/ldt-pin-staleness.yml: push to main (post-merge monitoring), a 6-hour schedule (catches drift with zero hauska-factory activity -- the exact CTX-SITUS-SKIP shape), and workflow_dispatch (on demand before a publish build)
ciVsScript.networkReachability: not assumed -- ci.yml's existing test job already does actions/checkout against a different empressaioemail-tech sibling repo (hauska-engine) at a pinned SHA, and gh api confirms that step succeeded on the most recent run (34424903446) at this branch's own base commit 52c1b78. Will additionally verify with a real workflow_dispatch run against legacy-design-tools before close, not by analogy alone.
